slides.title: How often should you replace your toothbrush?
Every 3–4 months
slides.text: That's what the American Dental Association recommends.

slides.title: If the bristles fray
slides.text: Worn, splayed bristles don't clean along the gumline as well.

slides.title: Same rule
slides.text: Swap the brush head every 3–4 months too.

slides.title: Let it air-dry
slides.text: Store it upright and uncovered, so it dries between brushings.
